prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A high-angle, wide shot of a modern, minimalist loft apartment interior, captured from an elevated corner near the ceiling. The scene is lit with soft, cool artificial lighting, creating gentle shadows and a calm, slightly subdued atmosphere. In the center of the room, a person dressed in all black, including a jacket and pants, is lying face-down on a pair of modular, pastel-colored ottomans—one pink, one beige—suggesting exhaustion or relaxation. To the right, another figure stands near a tall window, dressed in a bright green, full-body outfit with a hood, their face obscured, adding a surreal or playful element to the otherwise realistic setting. The background features tall windows with reflections, a high ceiling, and a bar-height table with stools, on which various bags and personal items are scattered. In the foreground, a kitchen counter is cluttered with cups, bottles, and dishes, hinting at recent activity or a gathering. The color palette is dominated by neutral tones—white walls, brown floor, black and beige furniture—punctuated by the striking green of the standing figure and the soft pastels of the ottomans. The overall composition emphasizes the spaciousness and clean lines of the apartment, with a sense of candid, everyday life and a touch of whimsy from the unusual attire of the standing figure.
